label: PF Backlog 153
title: Log conventions: run-scoped per-agent logs + backend/dashboard logs (+ INDEX)
body: config/log-conventions.json + core/log_router.py (single writer). Layout: products/<project>/logs/<run_id>/<stage>-<agent>.log (per agent), <run_id>-pipeline.log (overall/run), product-forge/logs/pipeline-backend.log, dashboard/logs/dashboard.log. Line format ts|level|run_id|stage|agent|event|message; logs/<run_id>/INDEX.json lists logs+sizes. Wired: agent_runner (agent_start/complete), stage_runner (stage_complete + INDEX), run_entry (backend + run log). One writer per file.
